people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.
translations.bsb: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father also loves those born of Him.
translations.kjv: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.
translations.asv: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is begotten of God: and whosoever loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.
